title: polygala amarella var. uliginosa
intro: Polygala amarella var. uliginosa, commonly known as Marsh Bedstraw, is a plant species belonging to the Polygalaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to support the immune system, reduce inflammation, and aid in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Polygala amarella var. uliginosa include its immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which make it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
